text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Tueseday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- According to unofficial results 40 mayors were elected in the first round of local elections -- the ruling Social Democratic Alliance SDAM has 13 mayors; opposition coalition including internal Macedonian Revolutionary Organisation - Democratic Party for Macedonian National Unity (VMRO-DPMNE), Democratic Party (DP) and the Movement for Macedonian Action (MAAK) - 11 mayors; Party of Democratic Prosperity (PDP) - nine mayors; Socialist party - four mayors.

- Out of a total pool of councillors across the nation of 10902, SDAM has the most with 503, followed by VMRO-DPMNE with 339 and the Socialist party with 147. The Democratic party has 104, Liberal party 102 and PDP has 92.

- In Skopje the independent candidate for mayor Ljupco Nikolovski leads with 34,942 votes. The opposition coalition candidate Risto Penov has 34,752 votes and SDAM's Jovica Ugrinovski 30,806 votes. These candidates will run in the second round on December 1.
- President of the state election commission Ljiljana Ristova said the turnout at the elections was about 65 percent, the electoral process passed without "any major problems".

- the Council of Europe observer mission said elections passed in a "calm and orderly atmosphere" but added many citizens could not vote because they were not included in the electoral lists. In 13 electoral polls in Tetovo almost 25 percent of the people could not vote because of incomplete lists.
- VMRO-DPMNE said "25 percent of the voters were forced to abstain from voting" at these elections. Neverthless the opposition has shown strength in Macedonia it said.
- SDAM expressed satisfaction with the election results. "The idea for early elections will be defeated."

- Nova Makedonija correspondent was thrown out of the rooms of the Party of Democratic Prosperity of Albanians (PDPA) who also stopped the independent A1 television from covering the elections in the Tetovo region.
